items.title: GameStop stock jumps with eBay investment expected to boost Q2 profit
items.summary: GameStop said it expects a Q2 profit increase, helped by its stake in eBay.

items.title: Shopify Falls 4% as Profit Taking Follows 18% Monthly Run, eBay and Etsy Slip
items.summary: Shopify shares are sliding hard on a quiet Monday with no downgrade, no news, and no company announcement, leaving traders to ask whether the August rally is simply running out of air or something bigger is starting to unwind.

items.title: GameStop's $300 Million Profit Has a $238 Million Catch
items.summary: A gain tied to its eBay investment helped lift earnings even as quarterly sales continued to fall.

items.title: GameStop Q2 2026 preliminary results: sales down, profit up
items.summary: The video game retailer posted an estimated $290 million to $310 million in net income, boosted by gains on its eBay stake

items.title: GameStop Climbs 4% as $358M Cash Payment Caps Dilution, Roblox Slips, Take-Two Interactive Treads Water
items.summary: GameStop just rewrote the terms of a billion-dollar note exchange overnight, and the stock is responding, but the earnings story behind the move is more complicated than the headline gain suggests.

items.title: GameStop Sees Higher Profit as eBay Investment Offsets Lower Sales
items.summary: The videogame retailer said it expects second-quarter profit to climb, boosted by investment gains from its stake in eBay, but said sales likely fell from a year earlier.

items.title: Executive Sells Nearly 2,300 Shares of eBay Stock, Valued at More Than $235,000
items.summary: Sweetnam disposed of shares valued at ~$237,000 to cover tax obligations from RSU vesting, maintaining a direct stake of 32,239 shares worth $3.25 million.

items.title: Is The Slide In eBay Stock Actually Worth Buying?
items.summary: When eBay falls in a crisis, the damage is concentrated in the depth of the drop, not the time it takes to climb back out.
